rounds.text: Royale Manor Hotels & Industries Ltd trades at a price-to-book ratio of 0.82x with shares at ₹ 26.2 against a book value of ₹ 32.1 [E2], representing a tangible discount to its asset base that becomes even starker when compared to the sector benchmark price-to-book of 2.15x [E7]. This asset discount sits alongside compelling intrinsic value metrics, as a discounted cash flow analysis estimates intrinsic value at ₹ 49 per share, providing a 47.0% margin of safety relative to the current market price [E44, E45]. Furthermore, a reverse DCF indicates that the market price only prices in a modest 9.1% earnings growth rate, which falls well shy of the 18.0% growth assumed in the base case [E46]. The underlying business fundamentals show robust medium-term momentum, highlighted by a 44% compounded profit growth rate over 5 years that significantly outpaces the 2% decline in the stock price over the same period [E19, E47]. Growth investments are also actively underway, evidenced by a 60.0% increase in capital work-in-progress to reach ₹ 1.76 Cr by March 2026 [E40]. Conceded: [E4], [E5], [E6], [E20], [E21].
